in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrasekhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Chandrasekhar' is derived from Sanskrit, with 'Chandra' meaning 'Moon' and 'Sekhar' meaning 'Lord of Wisdom and Wealth'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Surya (Sun God) and Chandra (Moon God). It is believed that those named Chandrasekhar are blessed with the qualities of wisdom, prosperity, and spiritual understanding.
